Coffee room on Ledra Street

What guests order

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Homemade lemonade

15 reviews mention the lemonade, some also the passion fruit version and the rose cordial.

Cakes

Apple pie, carrot cake and lemon cheesecake. 9 reviews mention the apple pie, 8 the carrot cake, 6 the lemon cheesecake.

Coffee and chocolate

Cypriot coffee with a biscuit, iced coffee, hot chocolate, and non dairy milk for those who want it.

Cocktails in the evening

In the evening the coffee room serves cocktails and its own signature drinks. Among the 210 reviews we read, 13 mention cocktails.

Inside Pieto

Photos from the Google listing of Pieto.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Cafe cats

16 reviews mention the cats that live in the cafe; one guest advises giving them a stroke and saying hello.

Water on the house

15 reviews mention the free water, some also crisps or homemade biscuits served with it.

Vintage rooms

Old furniture, fringed lamps and plants. One guest describes a quiet place for reading or working, with fast internet.

From Ledra Street to the next street

Pieto is at Ledras 207 and runs all the way back to the next street. Inside are stone walls, patterned floor tiles, old armchairs and lamps with fringes; the window says news, treats and coffee room. It is open every day from 8:00 until 2:00 at night.

What guests say

Three of 1,132 Google reviews, 842 of them with five stars.

“A cool little cafe on Ledras Street, I went there a couple of times whilst in Nicosia. The service is friendly and prompt, there are a few friendly cats that enjoy the cafe also, make sure you give them a stroke and say hello.”

Google review
“Friendly staff. The lemonade is INCREDIBLE. Comfortable seats and a very relaxing atmosphere. Good coffees also available. Local hotspot as well as for tourists. Staff have a great level of spoken English.”

Google review
“Probably the most hipster place in Nicosia. Friendly atmosphere, nice hard-working staff and free bottles of water and crisps. Located on the main street, but it goes all the way back to the next street. Reasonable menu. Nice!”
